properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 8 at 8:45AM CDT until August 9 at 5:00PM CDT by NWS Corpus Christi TX
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in Texas...

Nueces River Near Tilden affecting McMullen County.

For the Nueces River...including Cotulla, Tilden, Three Rivers,
Mathis, Bluntzer, Calallen...Minor flooding is forecast.

- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage just
after midnight tonight and continue falling to 8.1 feet Thursday
morning.
- Flood stage is 14.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Even 6 inches of fast-moving flood water can knock you off your feet
and a depth of 2 feet will float your car. Never try to walk, swim,
or drive through such swift water. If you come upon flood waters,
stop, turn around and go another way.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/crp.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 8 at 11:28AM CDT until August 8 at 1:30PM CDT by NWS Shreveport LA
properties.description:
FFWSHV

The National Weather Service in Shreveport has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Central Howard County in southwestern Arkansas...
Central Sevier County in southwestern Arkansas...

* Until 130 PM CDT.

* At 1128 AM CDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing

This includes the following streams and drainages...
Buck Creek, Pond Creek, Sand Creek, Rock Creek, Cossatot River,
Hale Creek, Bear Creek, Twomile Creek, Little Cossatot River,
Little Bear Creek, Rolling Fork, Cool Easy Creek, Bridge Creek,

properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 7 at 11:00AM AKDT until August 8 at 1:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Yentna River including Lake Creek.

* WHEN...Until 100 PM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1053 AM AKDT, the river remains in moderate flood stage
after heavy rains earlier this week, but is beginning to
subside. The river crested at 22.52 ft around 8pm Thursday,
August 7th.
- For Yentna River at Lake Creek:
At 9:50am the stage was 22.3 feet.
Flood Stage is 20.5 feet.

Impacts:
At 20.5 feet: Anglers Inn & King Point Lodges will have water
in several cabins.



At 22.0 feet: McDougal's, King Point, Anglers Inn, Wilderness
Place, Lake Creek Lodge, 3-Rivers, and Cottonwood Resorts
will have water in a number of cabins with water also
encroaching the main lodge buildings.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Stay tuned to further developments by listening to your local radio,
television, or NOAA Weather Radio for further information.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 8 at 12:28PM EDT until August 8 at 1:00PM EDT by NWS Charleston WV
properties.description:
SVRRLX

The National Weather Service in Charleston West Virginia has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northeastern Kanawha County in central West Virginia...
West central Clay County in north central West Virginia...

* Until 100 PM EDT.

* At 1226 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Elkview, or
10 miles northeast of Charleston, moving southeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage
to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Charleston, Clendenin, Pinch, Elkview, Glen, and Coal Fork.

This includes the following highways...
Interstate 79 between mile markers 1 and 18.
Interstate 77 in West Virginia between mile markers 105 and 109.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of
a building.

Frequent cloud to ground lightning is also occurring with this storm.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with this storm, and may lead
to flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded
roadways.

properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood

killers in heavy rains. Campers and hikers should avoid streams or
creeks.
